def count_laydowns(image_path, threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny", padding=20):
    # Load the image and apply the threshold for detection
    image = Image.open(image_path)
    image = image.convert('L')
    image = image.threshold(threshold)
    image = image.resize((32, 32))
    
    # Detect objects with the model
    execution = tool.execute(image=image, labels=["human"], model_size=model_size, padding=padding)
    detected_objects = execution["output_type"][1:]

    # Count the number of objects that are considered to be on the bed
    laydowns = sum([1 for obj in detected_objects if obj == "bed"])

    return laydowns
